iCapital is seeking a Vice President or Senior Vice President to lead Pricing Strategy and support one of iCapital's most important strategic functions. This role sits at the center of key business decisions, partnering closely with senior executive leadership to develop pricing strategies that drive growth, profitability, and long-term enterprise value. This role will help shape pricing frameworks, evaluate client and product opportunities, assess competitive dynamics, and develop data-driven recommendations that balance commercial objectives with sustainable economics. Operating at the intersection of strategy, finance, analytics, and business development, this role offers significant executive visibility and the opportunity to influence firm-wide commercial strategy across products, channels, and geographies.

- Partner directly with executive leadership on strategic pricing decisions, commercial opportunities, and business growth initiatives.

- Design and enhance pricing frameworks that support product positioning, value-based pricing, and long-term competitive differentiation.

- Own and maintain the Global Standard Pricing Compendium, ensuring pricing frameworks remain current, scalable, and consistently applied.

- Build and maintain pricing precedents, historical decisions, and supporting documentation to improve consistency and decision quality.

- Draft, implement, and maintain pricing policies, governance standards, and control procedures.

- Develop pricing analyses, dashboards, and reporting on pricing trends, fee realization, take rates, margin performance, and business mix evolution.

- Conduct market, competitor, and industry research to evaluate pricing trends, fee compression risks, and emerging commercial strategies.

- Partner closely with Strategic Finance teams to model revenue opportunities, cost structures, profitability, and return on investment for pricing decisions.

- Develop best-in-class disclosures and client-facing language describing iCapital's pricing methodologies, value proposition, and commercial arrangements.

Qualifications

- 9 - 15 years of experience in pricing strategy, management consulting, strategic finance, investment banking, private equity, corporate strategy, or other analytical and commercial leadership roles

- Experience developing pricing strategies, commercial frameworks, revenue optimization initiatives, or profitability analyses within financial services, fintech, asset management, or related industries

- Exceptional analytical capabilities, including financial modeling, business case development, pricing analytics, and quantitative decision support.

- Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and effectively communicate complex analyses to C-suite audiences and synthesizing large amounts of data into actionable recommendations and executive-ready presentations

- Strong commercial judgment with the ability to balance revenue growth, profitability, client needs, and competitive positioning

- Experience working cross-functionally with finance, sales, product, operations, legal, and executive leadership teams

- Track record of building processes, governance frameworks, and scalable operating models in evolving organizations

- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to develop executive materials, committee presentations, policies, and client-facing content

- Previous experience leading teams and developing talent is preferred

Employees also receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes an employer matched retirement plan, generously subsidized healthcare with 100% employer paid dental, vision, telemedicine, and virtual mental health counseling, parental leave, and unlimited paid time off (PTO).

The Assistant Vice President, HR Operations for Total Rewards will serve as the People team’s key operational and technology partner for global Total Rewards programs, including benefits, payroll, retirement, compensation, and leaves. Reporting to the Vice President, HR Technology, this role will improve the systems, data, integrations, and processes that support these programs.

Partnering closely with Total Rewards colleagues and other HR team members, this role will understand business needs, assess processes, identify requirements and dependencies, and translate these into practical system and operational solutions. The incumbent will also configure and test HR system functionality and oversee related work performed by third-party consultants, vendors, or technology partners. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who combines HR functional knowledge, systems experience, project management, analytical thinking, and a consultative, solution-oriented mindset.

Responsibilities

- Translate Total Rewards program requirements into operational workflows, functional specifications, system configuration, reports, controls, and integration designs, supported by clear documentation.

- Apply benefits and payroll expertise to assess how requirements affect employee records, eligibility, deductions, payroll results, vendor files, reporting, compliance, integrations, and employee experience.

- Analyze how evolving requirements affect employee records, eligibility, deductions, payroll results, vendor files, reporting, compliance, and the employee experience.

- Provide dedicated support for annual and recurring processes, including open enrollment, plan-year configuration, payroll changes, annual limits and rate updates, vendor and carrier implementations, integration changes, and other scheduled projects.

- Evaluate configuration and enhancement requests by clarifying the business problem, assessing impacts and dependencies, identifying risks, and recommending scalable solutions.

- Partner with external implementation and support resources while maintaining internal ownership of requirements, design decisions, configuration, testing, and solution quality.

- Review vendor recommendations critically to ensure proposed solutions address the underlying business need and are appropriate for the broader HR technology environment.

- Maintain documentation of system configurations, business rules, technical dependencies, decision rationales, and approved changes.

- Partner with internal and external technical resources and relevant HR subject matter experts to design, test, implement, monitor, and troubleshoot data feeds and system integrations.

- Develop a detailed understanding of inbound and outbound interfaces, including file layouts, field mappings, transformation rules, timing, dependencies, validation, error handling, reconciliation requirements, and downstream impacts.

- Conduct root-cause analysis when system, data, payroll, eligibility, or integration issues occur, and lead sustainable corrective actions. Ensure defects are documented, prioritized, resolved, retested, and formally closed.

- Promote clear ownership and governance for critical data elements, interfaces, operational controls, and issue resolution.

- Partner with HR stakeholders to understand business objectives, pain points, plan/policy requirements, service expectations, and operational risks.

- Identify opportunities to eliminate unnecessary steps, reduce manual intervention, strengthen controls, improve service delivery, and automate repeatable work.

- Support the development of a more resilient HR operating environment that reduces dependency on individual knowledge and third-party resources.

Qualifications

- 7+ or more years of progressive experience in payroll operations, benefits operations, HR business analysis or HR technology

- Experience implementing and managing Benefits, Payroll, Core HR, Reporting, and related modules within enterprise human capital management platforms such as Ceridian/Dayforce, including enhancements, upgrades, testing, release management, and production support

- Experience implementing and supporting HR data integrations, especially inbound and outbound carrier feeds

- Experience supporting annual and recurring HR processes, including open enrollment, plan-year configuration, payroll changes, rate updates, vendor and carrier implementations, and related integration changes

- Able to explain technical concepts to functional stakeholders and business requirements to technical stakeholders

- Sound judgment and discretion when working with sensitive payroll, benefits, and organizational data

- Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and experience working with large datasets to perform reconciliations, audit reports, and data analysis

- Project management, business analysis, HR, payroll, benefits, or HR technology certification is helpful but not required

- Experience using automation, workflow, or AI-assisted tools to improve documentation, analysis, controls, reporting, or service delivery, with appropriate human review and validation is preferred

Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $ 115,000 to $ 140,000.  iCapital offers a compensation package which includes salary, equity for all full-time employees, and an annual performance bonus. Employees also receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes an employer matched retirement plan, generously subsidized healthcare with 100% employer paid dental, vision, telemedicine, and virtual mental health counseling, parental leave, and unlimited paid time off (PTO).

We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office Monday-Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday.

About the Role

We are seeking a VP/SVP, Product & Audience Marketing to join iCapital’s International Marketing & Communications team. Based in Lisbon, this role will be responsible for driving product positioning, go-to-market initiatives, audience engagement, and sales enablement across LATAM and Canada.

The successful candidate will work closely with Product, Platform Solutions, Client Solutions, regional business leaders, International Marketing & Communications team members, and the U.S. Product Marketing Team to ensure iCapital’s products, solutions, and capabilities are effectively brought to market outside the U.S. The role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution and requires a strong understanding of financial services, wealth management, and private markets.

Key Responsibilities

Product & Go-to-Market Strategy

- Develop and execute go-to-market plans for products, solutions, and platform capabilities.

- Partner with Client Solutions, Product, and regional leadership to translate business priorities into actionable marketing strategies.

- Support the international launch and adoption of new offerings, ensuring clear and differentiated positioning.

Audience Marketing & Campaigns

- Develop audience-led marketing programs targeting wealth managers, banks, and advisors.

- Drive regional campaigns, thought leadership initiatives, webinars, content programs, and event-related marketing activities.

- Partner with U.S.-based Demand Generation and Digital teams to optimize engagement and audience growth.

Localization & Sales Enablement

- Adapt U.S. marketing materials for regional use where possible, ensuring relevance, compliance, and commercial effectiveness.

- Develop new sales enablement content, presentations, messaging frameworks, and client-facing materials.

- Collaborate with Compliance and Legal teams to support regional regulatory requirements.

Stakeholder Management & Performance

- Act as a strategic marketing partner to regional business leaders and Client Solutions teams.

- Measure campaign effectiveness and provide insight-driven recommendations.

- Support the continued development of the International Product & Audience Marketing function and operating model.

Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in product marketing, audience marketing, asset management, wealth management, fintech, or financial services.

- Strong understanding of private markets, alternatives, investment products, or wealth management.

- Experience developing go-to-market strategies, product positioning, and multi-channel marketing campaigns.

- Proven ability to translate complex concepts into compelling, client-focused marketing materials.

- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

- Experience working across international markets and multiple time zones.

- Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

Why This Role Matters

As iCapital continues to expand internationally, this role will help ensure our products, platform capabilities, and strategic initiatives are effectively positioned and adopted across diverse markets. The position plays an important role in connecting product strategy, commercial priorities, and client engagement, helping drive the continued growth of iCapital's International business.

iCapital is looking to hire a Strategic Finance professional to join the Corporate Finance team. This role will involve large scale responsibilities across financial and managerial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, analysis of key financial and performance indicators, monthly and quarterly management reporting duties, including support during the financial close, financial modelling, and partnership with key business and department Leads to enhance decision making. This individual will report into the iCapital Solutions Business Controller, Senior Vice President.

Responsibilities

- Support the budgeting and forecasting of the company’s key financial performance indicators, with emphasis on revenue, expenses, sales activity, and select GAAP and Non-GAAP metrics, liaising with FP&A team members, sales and business leads, while providing analysis of budget vs. actuals and real-time forecasting of revenue and expenses.

- Assist in the preparation of the company’s annual budget process across key financial performance indicators, with emphasis on revenue, expenses, sales-based inputs and activity, and client level detail.

- Develop key financial and performance metrics with detailed analytics for the Management Committee and business leads.

- Liaise with FP&A team members to develop business specific key performance metrics, client analytics, budgets, and forecasts.

- Identify and assess key opportunities to enhance the current reporting structure and develop new approaches to evaluate business performance.

- Partner with FP&A team members and sales to develop monthly analyses and insights into variances between budget vs. actual results.

- Perform sales analytics to support the business development and growth of the company’s iCapital Solutions department.

- Support the preparation of monthly management and quarterly board reporting packages, including consolidation of financial statements, budget vs. actual results and revised forecasts, variance analysis and compilation of the company KPI reports.

- Identify and remediate process gaps and implement effective internal controls; improve documentation of internal control processes.

- Assist in completing ad hoc projects as needed such as implementation of new software, platform reporting automation, and financial planning and analysis tools.

Qualifications

- 9+ years of FP&A, strategic finance, corporate finance, or accounting experience within the financial services industry and/or FP&A or strategic finance experience with a top-tier firm

- Familiar with private market investments such as private equity, hedge funds, and/or structured investments are preferred

- Experience in planning and ERP tools (i.e., WorkDay Adaptive, Tableau, Essbase, etc.) and familiar with Oracle NetSuite and/or General Ledger systems (i.e., PeopleSoft, Axiom) is preferred

- Able to work with business/sales and department leads on business performance including budgeting, forecasting and advanced analytics

- Advanced degree and/or credentials desired, such as MBA, CPA, CFA

- Strong organizational planning, quantitative modeling, and problem-solving skills; strategic and creative thinking
